A Punnett square showing a monohybrid cross between two heterozygous (Tt) parents. The top row shows the gametes T and t from one parent. The left column shows the gametes T and t from the other parent. The four inner squares show the combinations: one TT, two Tt, and one tt.

A side-by-side comparison diagram of Mitosis and Meiosis. On the left (Mitosis): A single diploid parent cell (2n) undergoes one division to produce two identical diploid daughter cells (2n). On the right (Meiosis): A single diploid parent cell (2n) undergoes two consecutive divisions to produce four non-identical haploid daughter cells (n).
